findings.evidence: test_session_bounds_update_without_stacking_and_preserve_explicit_values asserts installed.__bases__ == (original,) without monkeypatching/restoring fastmcp_http.StreamableHTTPSessionManager; the session_http_app-based tests defined later in the same file install the subclass globally and never rest
findings.title: Idempotence test depends on module-global install state and file ordering

findings.evidence: if the SDK's idle-expiry handler, triggered by scope.cancel(), also pops the session id from _server_instances, the pop-then-cancel order in _evict_idle_session depends on that handler not raising on a missing key; the ASGI test asserts termination and post-eviction state, but a swallowed background
findings.title: Eviction assumes SDK cleanup tolerates an already-unregistered session

findings.evidence: brain_v42.server.session_eviction_unavailable is logged without naming the missing attribute (which is known at the raise site), making operator triage of SDK drift harder than necessary.
findings.title: Drift error log omits which attribute is missing

findings.evidence: _install_session_idle_timeout(seconds: float, max_sessions: int = 6000) repeats the 6000 from config.py's mcp_http_max_sessions field; the sole call site always passes the setting, so today this is inert, but the two defaults could silently diverge if config.py changes.
findings.title: Hardcoded default duplicates the config default
